code_identity_contract.submission_value: EXPECTED_COMMIT is the exact full candidate SHA
code_identity_contract.required_equality: EXPECTED_COMMIT == clean formal worktree HEAD == manifest code commit

topology.gpu_rule: each learner rank uses only its node-local GPU zero

measurement.numeric_interval: each fragment's contiguous update zero through forty-nine
measurement.single_update_gate: first successful production commit per fragment versus independent Stage 0-C oracle
measurement.drift_gate: first-ten and last-ten maxima over exactly fifty contiguous commits per fragment
measurement.speed_common_interval: the same predeclared monotonic start and ten-second end for every rank and both control/injected trials
measurement.speed_formula: completed local optimizer steps multiplied by fixed input tokens per step divided by the common interval
measurement.unaffected_formula: abs(injected_rate/control_rate - 1) for learners zero through two, each <= 0.02

evaluation_snapshot.freeze: capture the complete ordered authority tuple once, freeze version vector plus state/content/authority identities, then materialize immutable named fragment payloads
evaluation_snapshot.load: validate the manifest identity and load only its exact named payloads; no per-fragment current/latest read is permitted
evaluation_snapshot.concurrency_counterexample: advance current authorities after capture and prove the loaded evaluation vector and content remain byte-identical to the capture

progress_and_stop.global_cycle: minimum independent per-fragment outer update count
progress_and_stop.reports: learner local steps/input tokens and fragment outer counts/accepted tokens/fresh/stale contribution counts are separate fields
progress_and_stop.stop: a frozen global-cycle/wallclock/compute/token/FLOP policy; no fastest-learner local-step stop

byte_accounting.steady_state: per-fragment current input, selected proposal reads, successor output, and zero full-model operations
byte_accounting.full_model_exception: the frozen evaluation snapshot is explicitly classified as evaluation rather than steady state

formal_package: S1-00 evidence builder/finalizer/validator with code config source skill scheduler role path identities and checksums; fail if evidence root exists
failure_ladder: preserve the first L2 failure, reproduce the failing role or analyzer on one compute node, and do not resubmit four nodes until the reduced case passes
